summary: Fixed a Pi extension loading error where `ask-user.web.js` (a browser bundle) was placed in `~/.pi/agent/extensions/` and Pi tried to execute it as a backend extension. Refactored the registry layout so web bundles live in a dedicated `extensionWebDir()` outside Pi's auto-discovery, updated `registry-manager.ts`, `websocket-server.ts`, and `web-bundles.ts` accordingly, and migrated existing artifacts. Also added `inspectorTabs` to the runtime field validator and registered `activity`, `git`, `svelte`, and `unity` artifacts in `gizmo.registry.json`.
decisions: Web bundles for Pi extensions must live in a separate directory (`extensionWebDir()`), not in `~/.pi/agent/extensions/`, because Pi scans that directory for backend extensions and would try to execute Svelte browser imports — this is what caused the original `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'svelte/internal/client')` error.
`piExtensionWebBundles` now reads only from `extensionWebDir()` rather than `join(piAgentDir(), 'extensions')`.
Added `inspectorTabs` to the generic field validator in `load-web-extension.ts` so runtime type checking accepts it.
Registry manifest entries added for `activity`, `git`, `svelte`, and `unity` so their `.web.js` artifacts are recognized.
Renamed activity's default export to `function activity(_pi)` (was `gizmoExtension`) to match naming conventions.
errors: Initial `extensions.web` case edit attempt against `websocket-server.ts` failed because the old text did not match exactly; resolved by reading the current block and re-editing.
`gizmo.registry.json` edit failed on whitespace mismatch, resolved by rewriting the file via `write`.
